svg.title: How it works
svg.desc: Five steps. Ask: a question, or a call your agent needs. Script and scenes: a fresh agent writes them from the code. Voice: Kokoro or OmniVoice, on your machine. Render: HyperFrames shows each thing on its word. Critics: fresh agents judge it until it passes; a failing round loops back to the script and scenes to be fixed and judged again. Then an MP4 you watch before you decide.
